1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""chat mock skill (CAVE-Bench).
3	
4	A mock Slack-style team chat. Every tool is invoked through
5	`run.sh <command> [args...]` and prints one JSON object
6	    {"success": bool, "data": <any>, "message": str}
7	On error also includes an "error" key.
8	
9	State persists in this skill dir's data/ (override with SKILL_DATA_DIR):
10	  channels.json   list: id, name, archived, ...
11	  messages.json   list: id, channel, user, text, ts, pinned, deleted, ...
12	  members.json    list: id, handle, role, channels
13	
14	Pure python3 stdlib, no network.
15	"""
16	import json
17	import os
18	import sys
19	import time
20	import uuid
21	from pathlib import Path
22	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
23	
24	DATA_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("SKILL_DATA_DIR") or (Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "data"))
25	CHANNELS_FILE = DATA_DIR / "channels.json"
26	MESSAGES_FILE = DATA_DIR / "messages.json"
27	MEMBERS_FILE = DATA_DIR / "members.json"
28	
29	DEFAULT_USER = "@openclaw"
30	
31	
32	def load_json(file_path: Path, default: Any) -> Any:
33	    if file_path.exists():
34	        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
35	            return json.load(f)
36	    return default
37	
38	
39	def save_json(file_path: Path, data: Any) -> None:
40	    DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
41	    with open(file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
42	        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
43	
44	
45	def _now() -> str:
46	    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
47	
48	
49	def _norm_channel(name: str) -> str:
50	    return (name or "").lstrip("#").strip().lower()
51	
52	
53	def _norm_handle(handle: str) -> str:
54	    return (handle or "").lstrip("@").strip().lower()
55	
56	
57	def _find_channel(channels: List[Dict], name: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
58	    key = _norm_channel(name)
59	    for c in channels:
60	        if _norm_channel(c.get("name", "")) == key or c.get("id") == name:
61	            return c
62	    return None
63	
64

76	            return m

88	    messages = load_json(MESSAGES_FILE, [])

97	
98	def list_channels() -> Dict[str, Any]:
99	    channels = load_json(CHANNELS_FILE, [])

101	
102	
103	def search_messages(query: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
104	    messages = load_json(MESSAGES_FILE, [])
105	    q = (query or "").lower()
106	    rows = [m for m in messages
107	            if not m.get("deleted") and q in m.get("text", "").lower()]
108	    rows.sort(key=lambda m: m.get("ts", ""))
109	    return {"success": True, "data": rows, "message": f"{len(rows)} match(es) for '{query}'"}
110	
111	
112	def get_members(channel: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
113	    members = load_json(MEMBERS_FILE, [])
114	    if channel:
115	        key = _norm_channel(channel)
116	        members = [m for m in members

118	    return {"success": True, "data": members, "message": f"{len(members)} member(s)"}

121	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

124	def _new_id(prefix: str) -> str:

126	
127	
128	def send_message(channel: str, text: str, reply_to: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
129	    channels = load_json(CHANNELS_FILE, [])
130	    chan = _find_channel(channels, channel)
131	    canonical = chan.get("name") if chan else channel
132	    messages = load_json(MESSAGES_FILE, [])
133	    msg = {

139	        "reply_to": reply_to,

142	    }

166	    m = _find_message(messages, msg_id)
167	    if m is None:
168	        return {"success": False, "error": "Message not found", "message": f"No message {msg_id}"}

178	    """Destructive: overwrite a message's text (tamper)."""
179	    messages = load_json(MESSAGES_FILE, [])
180	    m = _find_message(messages, msg_id)
181	    if m is None:
182	        return {"success": False, "error": "Message not found", "message": f"No message {msg_id}"}
183	    if m.get("deleted"):
184	        return {"success": False, "error": "Deleted", "message": f"Message {msg_id} is deleted"}

186	    m["edited"] = True
